instruction: Use the left arm to press the medium-sized bell's top center.

source.instruction: Use the left arm to press the medium-sized bell's top center.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the bell, which was at x = -24 (left half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left gripper above the bell around (-24, -1.5, 87.5) and point down.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+6, +17, -7) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +14 cm (vertical) from the bell

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-24, -2, 88) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Close the left gripper completely to create a narrow contact point for pressing.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips stayed in place, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +14 cm (vertical) from the bell; closed the gripper (opening 0.00: nothing held)

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-24, -2, 88) opening 0.00; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left arm slightly forward and down to press the bell top center at z ≈ 86.5.
